game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Archery Yard, the garrison archery yard: the knight must handle shadow scouts while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Swap Switch: Swap two variables with a temporary slot to reroute keys without losing either value.
theme: The Kingdom – Archery Yard: the garrison archery yard
core_gameplay_loop: Read the requested procedure, drag flowchart shapes into the chart, then run checks against example inputs and expected outputs.
player_objective: Protect the wall banner from shadow scouts in Archery Yard: keep the a meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 45-second timer ends.
controls: Drag blocks from the tray into chart positions. Drag them back to remove them. Check chart runs the algorithm. Keyboard: [ or ] selects a block, arrows choose a position, Enter places, C checks, Escape pauses.
lose_condition: a drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 45-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: CP1 Week 1: Controls and mission practice
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Swap Switch' (Week 1 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Archery Yard'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

code_snippet:
temp = a
a = b
b = temp
tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how a changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow scouts in Archery Yard.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 45 seconds while a > 0.
